x.label: X
steps: Body is on your clipboard.
X opens with the text prefilled. Check it survived the URL encoding.
Attach media by hand if this draft has any — intent links cannot carry files.
Post, then paste the URL back here.

bluesky.label: Bluesky
steps: Body is on your clipboard.
Bluesky opens with the text prefilled.
Attach media by hand if this draft has any.
Post, then paste the URL back here.

reddit.label: Reddit
steps: Title copied first. Body is the second copy button.
Reddit opens on the submit page with both prefilled.
Read the subreddit rules before you hit post. Self-promo rules bite harder than the API ever did.
Post, then paste the URL back here.

discord.label: Discord
steps: Body is on your clipboard.
Discord opens. Pick the channel yourself — no compose URL can target one.
Paste and send.
Right-click the message, Copy Message Link, paste it back here.

instagram.label: Instagram
steps: Caption is on your clipboard.
Instagram opens. Hit Create and upload the image listed below.
Paste the caption.
Share, then paste the URL back here.

tiktok.label: TikTok
steps: Caption is on your clipboard.
TikTok Studio opens on the upload page. Upload the clip listed below.
Paste the caption.
Post, then paste the URL back here.

youtube_shorts.label: YT Shorts
steps: Copy the title first. The description is the second copy button.
YouTube Studio opens the upload dialog. Upload the clip listed above; vertical and under 3 minutes makes it a Short.
Paste the title and description. Links in a Short's description are not clickable.
Once it is up: Content, this Short, Details, Related video, pick the full run video shown above. That is the link viewers can tap.
Publish, then paste the Short's URL back here.
